main.content:
= Bioluminescent Organisms =

{{Infobox Concept
| name = Bioluminescent Organisms
| type = Biological Phenomenon
| description = Living organisms that produce light
}}

[[Category:Biological Concepts]]
[[Category:Biochemistry]]

[[Has description::Living organisms that produce light through biochemical reactions]]
[[Has field::Biochemistry]]
[[Has field::Marine Biology]]
[[Supports implementation::Fluorescent Coral Reefs]]

== Overview ==
Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms. It is a form of chemiluminescence where light energy is released by a chemical reaction.

== Mechanism ==
The reaction involves a light-emitting pigment called luciferin and an enzyme called luciferase. In the presence of oxygen, luciferase catalyzes the oxidation of luciferin, producing light.

== Examples ==
* Fireflies
* Deep-sea fish
* Certain mushrooms
* Some bacteria

== See Also ==
* [[Fluorescent Coral Reefs]]
* [[Chemiluminescence]]
